description: This file declares factory classes and creation functions for PUSCH decoders, demodulators, and processors, including configurations for software and hardware acceleration, within the ocudu namespace. It also defines related factory interfaces and configuration structures for 3GPP LTE/NR physical layer processing.

classes.name: pusch_decoder_factory
classes.description: Interface for creating PUSCH decoder instances.

classes.name: pusch_demodulator_factory
classes.description: Interface for creating PUSCH demodulator instances.

classes.name: pusch_processor_factory
classes.description: Interface for creating PUSCH processor and validator instances.

classes.name: ulsch_demultiplex_factory
classes.description: Interface for creating ULSCH demultiplexer instances.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the respective factory or object.

methods.name: create_pusch_decoder_empty_factory
methods.description: Creates a factory for an empty PUSCH decoder with specified PRB and layer limits.

methods.name: create_pusch_decoder_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a software-configured PUSCH decoder factory based on provided configuration.

methods.name: create_pusch_decoder_factory_hw
methods.description: Creates a hardware-accelerated PUSCH decoder factory based on provided configuration.

methods.name: create_pusch_demodulator_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a software PUSCH demodulator factory with specified equalizer, precoder, demodulation, EVM, and PRG factories.

methods.name: create_pusch_processor_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a software PUSCH processor factory with specified configuration.

methods.name: create_pusch_processor_pool
methods.description: Creates a pool of PUSCH processors based on the provided pool configuration.

methods.name: create_ulsch_demultiplex_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a software ULSCH demultiplexer factory.
